name: band side plank row with partner
description: A side plank with a rowing motion against a band held by a partner. It trains the lats and trunk stability.
instructions: Get into a side plank on one forearm, with a partner holding the band in front of you.
Grip the band with your top hand and keep your hips lifted.
Row your hand back toward your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Return slowly without letting your hips drop.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
